notes.title: FTL-like submarine game Diluvion gets Resubmerged update
notes.notes: Last year Holly Nielsen reviewed Diluvion, a game about being captain of a submarine straight out of Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea, and said, "While the watery depths you explore are a 3D space, when switching to an interior view of the submarines or cities you come across, the 3D transforms into hand-painted 2D graphics. These areas are where the style of Diluvion comes into its own, and the inspiration of Jules Verne is fully felt."She had some criticisms, particularly for its checkpoints, but also for the UI. Players had plenty of feedback for indie studio Arachnid Games too, and so they spent another year working on an update which they're now ready to launch. Resubmerged is a free update that makes salvaging more dynamic, adds depth to the looting, crew management, and sub upgrading systems, has more ship customization, and "enhanced visuals, new graphics settings, a complete UI overhaul with improved quest tracking and waypoints, the ability to save anywhere, and revamped landmark, navigation and pathfinding systems."It's a significant upgrade, one that also includes "new side quests, artwork and music alongside a number of quality-of-life improvements." Check it out on Steam.

notes.title: Diluvion Beta: June Update
notes.notes:
Hey there! It's been quite some time since our last announcement. We have a new update to the beta, and this is a big one!

The beta's main quest line is now complete from start to finish.

We've fleshed out the Abyssal Trench quite a bit, and there's a lot of new stuff to see there. 

Check out our update video here

We'd also like your input on what the full title should be: Right now it's between Diluvion: Accretion and  Diluvion: Sunken Grimoire. Let us know in the comments!

Changelist

Completed quest chain in Sunken Coast
Completed quest chain in Abyssal Trench
Items can be used in hazard battles while salvaging
Completely revised quest update HUD
Added 'Crew Overview', 'Sub Overview' panels to Captain's Tools
Fixed Sonar bug where signals were never decaying
Fixed bug where AI would use player's ammo 
Crew Exchange - crew can be placed on standby when swapping to a smaller ship
Fixed numerous small UI bugs
Revised munition effects
New scenes for forging an upgrade, swapping ships, upgrading chassis


What's Next
First on our todo list is to complete the script for the few remaining side quests so that we can begin full localization. While that's happening, we'll be working on gamepad implementation and general polish.

Thanks for reading, and we hope you enjoy the latest build. :)

notes.title: Patch 1.17.9
notes.notes:
Weekend Beta of 1.17.9 goes Live

PATCH NOTES
Japanese, Russian and Hungarian font issues resolved (Will still look buggy if you have certain texts open while switching, but will fix itself on reopening said texts)

Lun has its Inventory now.

Non-hostile subs can take more damage from player before becoming agressive.

Guests on the ship no longer get pressganged into going on adventures (and sometimes dying)

2D camera movement holds slightly longer before following cursor after talking to NPC's

Cumulative achievement updates fixed (Logging on and checking inventory/swapping ships should update missing achievements)

Atlantica class ships have their rear turret firing radius fixed.

 Various spelling /description fixes

 Ships with refletion probes (Manta, Derringer, Sul, Lun) no longer crash the game on reload.



A huge thank you for our awsome community for being patient and reporting the bugs they find to us. ːdoodleː

notes.title: Update Schedule
notes.notes:
While the majority of our resources are dedicated towards Diluvion 1.2 and the subsequent content patch, we still have plenty of changes scheduled until those big updates.

We might not have a new update every week, but when we do we'll be uploading it onto the beta branch on Fridays and leaving it up for at least 10 days in order to minimize bugs. Then, on Mondays, the update would become the live branch of the game.

We're constantly working to improve Diluvion. As always, we welcome and appreciate your feedback.

Good luck & have fun!

notes.title: Save Backups, Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hello fellow divers, hope you are all having a great March.

We're now releasing the save backup system in the main branch for both PC and Mac. Special thanks for those who tested this in the beta branch. Papa bless.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25932474/c3c357aee1097f557071a7528cea5ee72720e51d.jpg

We've talked about the backup system before, but just to refresh: This system creates a backup when you save if it's been more than 10 minutes since your last backup. The appear in the 'backups' folder inside the save file folder.
C:\Users\[username]\AppData\LocalLow\arachnid games\diluvion\savefiles

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25932474/ad52818485762da4dcd7102472d8655baefa17b5.png

All you need to do to use a backup is drag it from the backups folder into the main save folder.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25932474/ced1748bf56007c7de399f7ea729692be1126cd5.png

Other Updates

We're hard at work on the revisions to 1.2. We have a lot of great stuff coming, and we've been working on some core components as well that make it easier for us to create content, and a more stable game.

We also have a content update coming in April, but I don't want to spoil the surprise just yet.

For the updates beyond, here's a sneak peek at one of the new creatures we're working on. It's based on a humphead parrotfish, but these guys in particular can grow up to the size of a Beluga class sub.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25932474/e9305a424fe9982d3ca45c8aea3d4a4ad0da3cd9.png


Thanks again everyone for sticking with us; it's been sick to read everyone's discussions and improve the game with the community. :) 

Cheers,
-Arachnid Team

notes.title: Diluvion release date set for February
notes.notes:
When Tom and James got to grips with Arachnid Games and Gambitious Digital Entertainment's Diluvion at PAX, they described its crew management system as "equal parts FTL and Dragon Age". That's quite the combination and while the deep sea submarine exploration game was initially expected to launch late last year, it now has a concrete release date: February 2, 2017. With nine unique upgradable vessels, filled with bespoke weapons and "specialised" crew members, Diluvion drops players into a vast undersea world after the land above is flooded and subsequently frozen over. A "ceiling of impenetrable ice" blocks access to the surface, therefore you're tasked with battling hostile ships and whichever other terrors stalk the deep as you strive to defend your submersible and its crew. 

"But fighting isn’t the only key to staying alive; players will also have to manage food and oxygen, salvage and trade loot, collect bounties and discover the depths of a dangerous world brimming with uncharted harbors, factions, stories and secrets," says Gambitious in a statement. "Captains can even build their own home bases of operation to shelter their fleets while growing in notoriety and wealth."Diluvion will launch on Steam February 2 and will cost £14.99/$19.99. If pre-ordering is your thing, doing so will net you a 15 percent discount ahead of time and a 'Captain's Journal'—said to "document the game’s rich lore"—as well as a Deringer sub to use in-game.And if you want a sneak peek at Diluvion, Arachnid will be joining us live on today's PC Gamer Show to demo the game. Stop by our Twitch channel at 1pm PST to watch us play or ask them questions!
